items.title: Pizza Union King's Cross
items.check: article names King's Cross and Holborn; King's Cross branch used

items.title: Roti King (Euston)
items.memo: Malaysian mains GBP 9.50-11.95; try the dhal or a murtabak.
items.check: several branches in London; original Euston branch used

items.title: C & R Cafe Restaurant
items.memo: Chinatown noodle and rice mains around GBP 14.50.

items.title: Govinda's (Soho Street)
items.memo: Vegetarian and vegan dishes from GBP 3.50 to 5.50.

items.title: Indian YMCA Restaurant
items.memo: Canteen-style Indian food, GBP 4.50-9.50 a dish.

items.title: Devi Dhaba

items.title: Marie's Thai Cafe
items.memo: Fry-ups by day, Thai dishes GBP 8-12 later on.

items.title: Chinatown Bakery

items.title: Porterford Butchers
items.memo: Butcher doing hearty sandwiches to take away.

items.memo: Leather Lane stall known for big portions.

message.subject: I listed your London cheap eats guide on one map
message.body:
Hi Bri, I'm Adrian from PinWith, a map-list app.

Three curries with rice for GBP 6 at Devi Dhaba is the kind of tip I'd never find on my own, and the 24/7 Beigel Bake stop is a classic. I put 15 of the places into one map: https://pinwith.me/@pinwith_en/wanderingswithbri-london-cheap-eats

It's private for now: only this link opens it, and I'll delete it if you'd rather I didn't.

With PinWith, your readers can follow in your footsteps: revisit the places you went or plan their own trip from one map, in their own language. That helps your content reach further.

If you like it, I'll move it to your account, credited to you, so you can link it in the post. Lists like this can also earn curators extra income: https://pinwith.me/for-creators?lang=en
No reply needed if it's not useful.

Adrian
